# Realtor.com

> > America's home search platform providing real estate listings, school district ratings powered by GreatSchools.org and Precisely, and neighborhood insights for buyers, sellers, and renters.

Realtor.com is a comprehensive real estate marketplace offering property search tools, school district information, agent resources, and home living guides. The platform integrates data from trusted sources like GreatSchools.org and Precisely to help users make informed decisions about where to live.

## Key Topics

- School district ratings and information
- Homes for sale and rent listings
- Real estate search and property discovery
- Elementary, middle, and high schools
- Charter schools and public schools
- Neighborhood guides and community data
- GreatSchools.org ratings integration
- Precisely location data
- Buyer and seller agent services
- Property valuation and market trends
- Real estate listings and MLS data
- School attendance zones
- Community demographics and amenities
